description_en: Queries quality of service (QoS) policies in a specified region
description_zh: 调用DescribeQoses接口查询指定地域下QoS策略实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-qoses --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --qos-ids qos-oek3r2cmvk7m8q0000 --qos-name zxtest --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeQoses

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the QoS policy is deployed
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the QoS policy.

Separate multiple QoS polices with commas (,).
If you do not specify this parameter, all QoS policies in the region are queried
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略实例ID。

如果要同时查询多个QoS策略实例，多个实例ID之间以半角逗号（,）分隔开。
如果不填写该项，则默认查询该地域下所有QoS策略实例信息
parameters.name: qos_ids

parameters.help_en:
The name of the QoS policy.

The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_),and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略实例名称。

名称长度为2~100个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: qos_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含的条目数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含的条目数

QosDescription.description_en: The description of the QoS policy

QosId.description_en: The ID of the QoS policy

QosName.description_en: The name of the QoS policy

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the QoS policy belongs
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: QoS策略实例所属的资源组ID

SagCount.description_en: The number of the SAG instances to which the QoS policy is applied
SagCount.description_zh: QoS策略实例关联的智能接入网关实例数量

SmartAGIds.description_en: The IDs of the SAG instances to which the QoS policy is applied
SmartAGIds.description_zh: QoS策略实例关联的智能接入网关实例列表

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of QoS polices
